title: Retractable hooks and garment rod 10-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass | Traditional Pullout Garment Rod Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your traditional bathroom hardware with a retractable hooks and garment rod that pulls out for convenient hanging space and retracts when you want a cleaner, unobstructed look.

  • Space-saving pullout design: Extends for hanging garments or towels, then retracts when not in use
  • Wall mount installation: Installs in an end wall or door frame
  • Solid brass construction: Crafted from brass for enduring everyday use
  • Refined mounting: Concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Finish flexibility: Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs
Style: Traditional
Material: Brass
Mounting: Wall mount
Projection: 10 inches
Overall dimensions: 10-Inch L x 2-Inch W x 1.9-Inch H
Weight capacity: 10 lb
Wall depth required to retract: 10 inches
Included: Brass rod, rod housing, and all installation hardware
Assembly required: No

Warranty
Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Traditional Retractable Pullout Garment Rod
_previous.description: Enjoy the convenience of this pull out garment rod in many places around your home. Rod installs in an end wall or door frame and retracts when not in use. When the rod is extended it provides a handy place to hang your garments or towels. Great in a laundry area, dressing area or in the bathroom. Garment rod requires 10 inches of wall depth to retract. Crafted of the finest solid brass materials and provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
